cohort: Pregnant women with uterine contractions between 24 and 36th gestational weeks, but without dilatation or effacement, were included.
finding: Optimal cut-off values of CUCI were identified as predictors for preterm delivery (<37 weeks, <34 weeks, and <4 weeks after admission), suggesting its potential utility in predicting preterm delivery.
gest_age: 24-36 gestational weeks (at inclusion); <37 and <34 gestational weeks (for outcomes)
